sections.heading: Examples
sections.text: Treffen um 18.15 Uhr in Ort C! :: Meeting at 18:15 in Town C! Das Treffen ist eine Stunde vor dem Anpfiff. :: The meeting is one hour before kick-off.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: In a match message Treffen is when the players must be there, not when the match starts. The noun is the infinitive of sich treffen , so it is neuter.
